{{Quote|This remote area is the Jaga's Cluster System, an almost-unknown system bordering Wild Space.|[[Setenna Hase]]|<ref name="OaAI" />}}
'''Jaga's Cluster''', also known as the '''Jaga's Cluster system''' or the '''Jagomir system''',<ref name="OaAI" /> was a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
[[Cassus Fett]] led the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] in the [[Battle of Jaga's Cluster|annihilation]] of a major [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] force in the Jaga's Cluster during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] in [[3961 BBY]].
